title: 2005 AMC 10B Problem 20
statement: What is the average (mean) of all \(5\)-digit numbers that can be formed by using each of the digits \(1,\) \(3,\) \(5,\) \(7,\) and \(8\) exactly once?

solutions.text:
By symmetry, each of the five digits appears equally often in each place, so the average digit in every place is \[ \dfrac{1 + 3 + 5 + 7 + 8}{5} = 4.8. \]

The average number is therefore \[ \begin{gathered} \small 4.8(1 + 10 + 100 + 1000 + 10000) \\ = 4.8 \cdot 11111 = 53332.8. \end{gathered} \]

Thus, C is the correct answer.
